description: This file defines configuration classes and methods for managing Kafka cluster configurations with token-based security in Apache Spark, including reading configurations, redacting sensitive info, and setting defaults.

classes.name: KafkaTokenClusterConf
classes.description: Configuration data class for Kafka clusters with security settings, including sensitive info redaction.

methods.name: getClusterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a KafkaTokenClusterConf object from SparkConf for a given cluster identifier.

methods.name: getAllClusterConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves all Kafka cluster configurations defined in SparkConf.
